node.title: Re: Pick k numbers at random
node.author: Athanasius
node.doctext:
Hello [Chuma],

The core module [metamod://List::Util] has a shuffle function which does what you want:

use strict; use warnings; use Const::Fast; use Data::Dump; use List::Util qw( shuffle ); const my $N => 10; const my $K => 5; my @range = (shuffle 1 .. $N)[0 .. $K - 1]; dd \@range;

Sample output:

23:04 >perl 2029_SoPW.pl [10, 9, 5, 6, 7] 23:04 >

Hope that helps,
